script: セイバールート七日目-01
title: セイバールート七日目-01

pages.ja:
夕食が終わった。
俺以外は概ねいつも通りの夕食だったと思う。
こっちはと言うと、脱衣場での一件がちらついてメシの味さえ分からなかった。

pages.en:
——Dinner is over.

For everyone but me, I think it was a perfectly ordinary dinner.

I could not even taste the food. My mind kept returning to what happened in the changing room.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Dinner ends.
I think it was a normal dinner table for everyone except me.
As for me, I couldn’t even sense the taste with the scene in the dressing room flickering in my mind.

pages.ja:
「……さむ」
縁側の窓を開け、外の風で頭を冷やしていたがそれもここまでだ。
いつまでもこんなコトしていたら風邪を引いちまう。

pages.en:
“…Cold.”

I opened the veranda window to clear my head in the night air, but this is enough.

If I stay here much longer, I will catch a cold.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…It’s cold.”
I opened the window by the porch and I was cooling my head off, but I’m done with that.
I’ll catch a cold if I keep doing this.

pages.ja:
「シロウ、ここにいたのですか」
「セ、セイバー……！？ な、なんだよ、俺になんか用か」
「私ではなくシロウにあるかと。いいのですか？ 夜は凛に魔術を教わる、という約束だった筈ですが」
pages.jaRuby:
「シロウ、ここにいたのですか」
「セ、セイバー……！？ な、なんだよ、俺になんか用か」
「私ではなくシロウにあるかと。いいのですか？ 夜は凛に魔術を教わる、という約束だった筈ですが」
pages.en:
“Shirou. So this is where you were.”

“S-Saber…!? Wh-What is it? Did you need me for something?”

“Not I. I believe you are the one with business to attend to. Did you not promise to study magecraft under Rin at night?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou, you were here.”
“S-Saber…!? W-What? Is there some business?”
“I believe you have one and not me. I thought you were to learn magic from Rin at night.”

pages.ja:
「あ」
ぱし、と頭を叩く。
「すっかり忘れてた。さんきゅ、今すぐ行ってくる！」
pages.jaRuby:
「あ」
ぱし、と頭を叩く。
「すっかり忘れてた。さんきゅ、今すぐ行ってくる！」
pages.en:
“Oh.”

I smack myself on the head.

“I completely forgot. Thanks—I'll go right now!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh.”
I hit my head.
“I totally forgot. Thanks, I’ll go right away!”

pages.ja:
別棟に駆け込んで、二階にあがる。
遠坂が占拠した客間のドアをノックすると、
「士郎？ いいわよ、ちょっと今手が放せないから、勝手に入って」
なんて、どこか余裕のない遠坂の声が返ってきた。

pages.en:
I rush into the outbuilding and climb to the second floor.

When I knock on the door of the guest room Tohsaka has occupied, she calls back with an unusually strained voice.

“Shirou? Come in. My hands are full at the moment, so let yourself in.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
I run into the outbuilding and go to the second floor.
I knock on the door of the guest room that Tohsaka occupies.
“Shirou? It’s fine. I don’t have my hands free at the moment, so just come on in.”
Tohsaka’s voice comes back, somehow without composure.

「質問していいかな、遠坂」
「ひょっひまっへ。きょふののるまはこれへおはりだから」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Can I ask what you're doing, Tohsaka?”

“Jush a minuh. Thish ish the lasht one I need to do today.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Can I ask, Tohsaka?”
“Folf on. I’ll fe fone fife fofei’s fife fith.”

pages.ja:
言って、遠坂は注射器を自分の腕に刺す。
……カラの注射器に血が吸い上げられていく。
そうして摘出した血を今度は一滴一滴宝石に零したかと思うと、血に濡れたそれを握りしめた。

pages.en:
With that, Tohsaka sinks the needle into her arm.

…Blood rises into the empty syringe.

She draws it out, lets the blood fall drop by drop upon the jewel, then closes her hand around the wet stone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saying that, Tohsaka puts the needle into her arm.
…She draws blood out of herself.
And taking the blood, she drips it one drop at a time onto the jewel, and grasps the bloody jewel.

遠坂はがっくりと肩を落とし、宝石箱らしきものに石を戻す。

pages.en:
“…Haaah. All that, and it's still only at thirty percent. I suppose I really will have to make do with the nine I already have.”

Tohsaka's shoulders slump as she returns the stone to what looks like a jewel box.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Sigh. Only three tenths after this much. I guess I’ll have to do with the nine I have.”
Tohsaka slumps her shoulders and puts the stone back into some kind of a jewelry box.

pages.ja:
「遠坂。約束通り、教えを乞いに来たんだけど」
その前に、今の行為がとても気になるのだがどうしたものか。
pages.jaRuby:
「遠坂。約束通り、教えを乞いに来たんだけど」
その前に、今の行為がとても気になるのだがどうしたものか。
pages.en:
“Tohsaka. I'm here to learn, as promised.”

Though first, I am extremely curious about what she just did.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka, I’m here for your lesson, as promised.”
But first, I’m curious about what she was doing.

pages.ja: 「ええ、待ってたわ。昼間はセイバーと体の方を鍛えてたんでしょ？ なら夜は中身を鍛えないとね」
pages.jaRuby: 「ええ、待ってたわ。昼間はセイバーと体の方を鍛えてたんでしょ？ なら夜は中身を鍛えないとね」
pages.en: “Yes, I've been waiting. You trained your body with Saber during the day, didn't you? Then we need to train what's inside you at night.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Yeah, I was waiting. You were training your body with Saber during the day, right? Then you should train what’s inside during the night.”

pages.ja:
教える気まんまんなのか、遠坂はなにやら嬉しそうだ。
……ふむ。セイバーは人に教えるのは苦手だと言ってたけど、こいつは絶対逆のタイプだろうな。
いや、向いてるか向いてないかは別にして。

pages.en:
The prospect of teaching seems to delight her.

…Hm. Saber said she was poor at teaching others, but Tohsaka must be precisely the opposite sort.

Whether she is actually any good at it is another question.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Tohsaka seems happy as she’s more than ready to teach.
…Hmm. Saber said she wasn’t any good at teaching, but I bet this one’s the complete opposite.
No, putting that aside…

」
「いや、その前にちょっといいか。やっぱり気になる。
遠坂さ、さっき何してたんだよ。注射器を自分に刺すなんて危ないだろ」

pages.en:
“Now, where should we begin? You said Reinforcement is the only magecraft you can use——”

“Wait. There's something I need to ask first. It's still bothering me.

“What were you doing just now? Sticking a syringe into your own arm is dangerous.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Well, what should we start with? I think you were saying you can only use the strengthening magic”
“Actually, could I ask you something before that? I’m curious.
What were you just doing? It’s dangerous to use needles on yourself.”

pages.en: “Wait. What's a magic bullet, and what do you mean by transferring your magical energy?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hold on. What do you mean by magic bullet and transferring magical energy?”

pages.ja:
「魔弾は魔弾よ。魔力の籠った弾。
宝石は人の念が宿りやすいって聞いたコトない？ 実際、宝石は魔力を溜めやすい物なんだけど、うちの家系はさらに相性がいいみたいなのよね」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“A magic bullet is exactly what it sounds like: a projectile charged with magical energy.

“Haven't you heard that jewels readily absorb human thoughts? In truth, they readily store magical energy—and my family appears to have a particular affinity for them.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Magic bullets are magic bullets. It’s a bullet filled with magical energy.
Haven’t you ever heard that people’s thoughts tend to go into jewels? In practice, jewels are easy targets to transfer magical energy into, but it seems my family is even more compatible with it than most.”

pages.ja:
「魔力を込めるっていうのは、たとえば今日一日なにもしなかったら体力は余ってるでしょ？ その余った分の力を宝石にため込んでおくの。
これを何日、何ヶ月、何年と続けて、宝石自体を“魔術”にするのよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「魔力を込めるっていうのは、たとえば今日一日なにもしなかったら体力は余ってるでしょ？ その余った分の力を宝石にため込んでおくの。
これを何日、何ヶ月、何年と続けて、宝石自体を“魔術”にするのよ」
pages.en:
“Suppose you did nothing all day. You would have physical energy left over, wouldn't you? You store that excess power in a jewel.

“You continue for days, months, years, until the jewel itself becomes magecraft.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Transferring magical energy… well, for example, you have excess strength left over if you do nothing for the whole day, right? I’m storing that excess power in the jewels.
You keep on doing this for days, months, and years, and that turns the jewels themselves into ‘magic’.”

pages.ja:
「もっとも宝石自体にだってキャパはあるし、自分から離れた魔力なんてものは操れない。
宝石に込めた魔力っていうのは、あくまで大魔術を瞬間的に発動させる為だけのイグニッションにすぎないけどね」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Naturally, every jewel has a limit, and you cannot control magical energy once it has left your body.

“The energy stored in a jewel is only an ignition source for activating grand magecraft in an instant. Nothing more.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But then, the jewels have limited capacities and I cannot control magical energy outside me.
The magical energy inside the jewels is just an ignition to instantly activate a large-scale magic.”

「後方支援……？ んー、近いけど違うっていうか、使い捨てのリュックサックの中身をつめてるだけよ」

“…Hm? So you put your magical energy inside the jewel and make a backup?”

“Backup…? As in reinforcements? Close, but not quite. It's more like packing the contents of a disposable rucksack.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…? Um, so you’re putting your magical energy into the jewels as a backup?”
“Backup…? Hmm, close but not quite. I’m just filling up a single-use disposable backpack.”

pages.mirrorMoon: “So you mean you’re temporarily expanding the hard disk… that’s amazing. So you should be able to use as much magic as you want.”

pages.ja: 「はーどでぃすく……？ アンタの言ってるコトはよく判らないけど、そこまで便利なものじゃないわよ。魔力は宝石に込めた時点で、その宝石の属性に染まるから用途は限られてしまうわけだし」

pages.en:
“When a mage approaches death, they pass the achievements they attained to their successor as a Crest. ‘Take this and reach the place I could not. Perhaps the Crest this old man leaves behind will prove useful to you.’

“…Of course, both the one who leaves it and the one who receives it know the Crest will never be enough to reach that place.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“And the magus, on the verge of death, hands down this great accomplishment in a crest. Like saying ‘I give you this to reach the realms I could not reach, perhaps this crest I will give you might offer some help’.
…Well, the one handing it down and the one receiving both know the crest is of no help, though.”

pages.jaRuby: 「……？ なんだよ、それだけ凄い刻印なのに何の役にも立たないのか？」
pages.en: “…? What do you mean? If the Crest is that extraordinary, how can it be useless?”

pages.en:
“It isn't useless! For an ordinary life as a mage, one Crest is enough to let you live in comfort!

“…But it's like being given a car. No matter how quickly you travel across the earth, it can never carry you to the moon.”

“…?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“It is useful! If you’re a normal magus, it’s so useful that that one crest will provide you ease and comfort!
…But, well, it’s like inheriting a car. No matter how fast you can travel on the ground, you can never reach the moon.”
“…?”

pages.en:
“The head of a family devotes a lifetime to perfecting a form of magecraft, turns it into a Crest, and passes it down. The descendant perfects another form, adds it to the Crest, and hands it to the next generation.

“It grows more complex and accumulates a deeper history. That is the Magic Crest—an inescapable bond placed upon every mage.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“The head of the family puts the magic he devoted his life to into that crest and passes it on, and the descendant completes another magic increasing the crest, and passes it on again.
It grows more complex like that, and a deep history is engraved into it. That’s the Magic Cresta chain that the magus cannot free themselves from.”

“No, that's different. The history of the family is preserved in books. The Magic Crest contains only magecraft.

“It can perform incantations on its own and let you use magecraft you never personally mastered. The simplest comparison would be engraving a magic circle into your body.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh, that’s wrong. The record of the family is naturally left on paper. Only magic is in the Magic Crest.
It can cast spells automatically and allow you to use magics that you have not acquired yet.
To put it simply, it’s like carving a magic circle onto your body.”

pages.mirrorMoon: “…Hm. Then doesn’t that mean you can carve the crest on anyone? You can draw a magic circle as many times as you want if you know the shape of it.”

pages.en:
“It isn't that simple.

“A Magic Crest is almost a living thing. Transferring one resembles transplanting an organ.

“There is only one organ. It cannot be divided among several people or copied into a manuscript. Splitting a heart in two serves no purpose, does it? Neither half would function.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s not the way it works.
The Magic Crest is like a living thing. It’s almost like transplanting organs.
There’s usually only one of an organ, so you can’t give it away to numerous people or make copies of it. There’s no point in dividing the heart into two, right? Even if you separate it, it just stops functioning.”

pages.en: “Oh… Right. That makes sense. Then has a Crest been transplanted into you too?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Oh… hm. I see, you’re right. Then you had that crest transplanted into you too?”

“…Transplant was a rather unpleasant comparison, now that I hear it back.

“Mine is in my left arm, covering everything from shoulder to hand. But a Magic Crest appears only when used, so unlike a Command Spell, there's no need to conceal it.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…I guess the term transplant was a bad example.
In my case, it’s on my left arm from my shoulder to my hand. But the Magic Crest won’t show up unless I use it, so there’s no need to hide it unlike the Command Spell.”

“If a family has several children, all but one ordinarily grow up as normal people without being taught magecraft. Since the Magic Crest cannot be given to them, there is little purpose in developing them as mages.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…So, well, that’s why a family of magi is succeeded by only one descendant.
If the family happens to produce brothers or sisters, it is common for the rest of them to live normally without learning about magic. Since you can’t give them the Magic Crest, there’s not much point even if they succeed as a magus.”
